summary.intent: Execute all 9 plans of Phase 71 (Share-Invite Security & IPNS Data-Integrity API) in the cipher-box monorepo using wave-based parallel subagent execution, then autonomously run the full post-execution 'ship phase' loop (verify, secure, validate, simplify, SDK E2E gate, CodeRabbit review, PR creation, review resolution, learnings extraction) without user babysitting.
summary.outcome: All 9 plans executed across 4 waves with all gates green (typecheck, 894/894 API tests, cargo check, sdk-core/sdk tests); phase verified (16/16 truths) and shipped as PR #599, including a real live-stack proof of the D-06 concurrency fix, a genuine D-05 regression caught and fixed by the SDK E2E gate, a Greptile P1 stale-write-key bug fixed, and all 8 CodeRabbit findings fixed (not deferred) with 0 unresolved review threads; final CI confirmation was still in progress at transcript end.

repo: Repo is squash-merge-only (merge:false, rebase:false, squash:true, title=PR_TITLE) — individual commit subjects never reach main, so GSD's non-conventional 'feat NN-MM:' commit style doesn't need rewording before ship; only the PR title must be conventional and paren-free
commitlint's subject-no-parens rule is enforced only on the PR title via pr-title.yml CI job, not on individual commits — local commit-msg hook is disabled

CI's Migration Drift Check only fails on structural drift (CREATE/DROP TABLE, ADD/DROP COLUMN, ALTER TYPE, RENAME COLUMN) — it tolerates index/constraint name churn from `migration:generate`, so a huge generated diff can still be a pass
Throttling is relaxed under NODE_ENV=test (apps/api/src/app.module.ts:56) — the API's own dev server runs with NODE_ENV=test so THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET isn't required for full sdk-e2e runs

sdk-e2e auth requires SDK_E2E_SECRET (default 'e2e-test-secret-do-not-use-in-production' when vitest doesn't autoload .env) to match the API's TEST_LOGIN_SECRET ('e2e-test-secret-ci-only') or all suites cascade-skip after a 401 in beforeAll
API doesn't log handled 4xx responses — must temporarily add an axios response interceptor in packages/api-client/src/instance.ts to see err.response.data, then revert after diagnosis

tee-worker (:3002) /public-key returns 401 after a DB reset wipes tee_key_state, causing tee-republish test failures unrelated to code changes — a known environmental gotcha when resetting the local Postgres DB for live-stack testing
CI has a working TEE worker so tee-republish tests pass there even when they fail locally after a DB reset — confirms local-only environmental cause
GSD `update-plan-progress` calls flip the phase's ROADMAP.md box to [x] once all plans have summaries, independent of whether verification has actually run yet

gsd tracking-commit helper can report 'commit_failed' as a false negative while the commit actually lands — must verify via `git log --oneline -1`, not blind retry (previously known, reconfirmed twice in this session)

code.finding: D-05 same-seq CID-equivocation guard threw 400 whenever embeddedSeq===dbSeq with a different CID, but couldn't distinguish genuine equivocation from a forward-CAS attempt that lost a race; fixed to fall through to the CAS UPDATE (yielding correct 409) when expectedSequenceNumber === embeddedSeq - 1, confirmed via rotation-crash-safety e2e test and a new unit test

Greptile P1: widen-only merge logic advanced generation/read-key on a generation-bump re-claim via a write-capable invite onto an already-write-capable share, but left encryptedWriteKey wrapped for the old generation (isGenerationBump && inviteGrantsWrite but isWriteUpgrade=false case) — recipient silently lost write access post-rotation; fixed and covered with a new unit test

claimInvite allowed a write-capable invite to be claimed without an encryptedWriteKey, silently downgrading to read-only share; CodeRabbit flagged this MAJOR (reinforcing an earlier deferred finding) — fixed by adding pre-transaction validation rejecting the claim with 400 if a write invite lacks a write key

Permission-derivation used `writeDescriptorRef/encryptedWriteKey !== null` after a rename, but the DTO field type is string|null|undefined, so an undefined write key would be misclassified as 'write' capable — loosened both occurrences to `!= null`

Added composite (sharer_id, share_root_ipns_name) indexes on shares and share_invites per CodeRabbit N1; required matching class-level @Index decorators on share.entity.ts and share-invite.entity.ts to avoid Migration Drift Check failures (drift check compares entities vs migrated schema)

workflow: Wave-based parallel subagent execution: verify each spawned executor's worktree exists (via git config.lock release check) before dispatching the next agent in the same wave, to avoid config-lock races

Merge all worktrees in a wave together only after all agents in that wave return, then run a post-merge integration gate scoped to what the wave's plans actually touch (avoid running the full/wrong test command by inspecting root package.json scripts for a pnpm monorepo instead of defaulting to `npm test`)

When an agent flags a diagnostic (e.g. cargo E0560) that conflicts with its own reported passing checks, don't trust either blindly — settle it by re-running the check against the actually-merged tree, since intermediate worktree/LSP state can produce stale false positives

For blocking human-verify checkpoint plans, split the wave into an autonomous sub-wave (other plans) plus a separate handling path for the checkpoint plan; when the user delegates the live-stack run back to the agent, inspect the current live-stack state first (e.g. check if a port is already bound and by what/how stale) before resetting shared infra

Treat repeated CodeRabbit/Greptile findings on the same area as an escalation signal — the session reversed an earlier 'defer' decision to 'fix' once a second independent reviewer flagged the same MAJOR issue
Use `gh api -X PATCH repos/<owner>/<repo>/pulls/<N> -F body=@file` instead of `gh pr edit` when the repo has Projects-classic GraphQL issues blocking the edit endpoint
Poll GitHub PR checks/threads in the background with correct tab-delimited parsing for `gh pr checks` output (a naive awk split on spaces breaks on multi-word check names like 'CodeRabbit / Review')
Always `git fetch` and check for a bot-pushed `chore(release)` commit before pushing again, to avoid a rejected push or accidental overwrite

friction: CodeRabbit CLI review appeared to complete quickly but the PR-level CodeRabbit review was actually still processing ('skipping' status was a red herring) — the user had to correct the assistant's assumption that it was skipped
First CI-check poll script had a parsing bug (awk field split on spaces broke on the multi-word 'CodeRabbit / Review' check name), requiring a second corrected poll
Tracking-commit helper's known false-negative ('commit_failed') recurred twice during the session, requiring manual git log verification each time

DB reset (done at user's request to get a clean live-stack run) had the side effect of wiping tee_key_state, causing 2 unrelated tee-republish test failures that needed separate diagnosis to rule out as a regression
Stale compiled API process on :3000 (PID from an earlier, unknown-vintage build) had to be discovered and killed before a meaningful live-stack test run could occur
Root cause diagnosis of the D-05 regression required temporarily instrumenting packages/api-client/src/instance.ts with a debug interceptor since the API doesn't log handled 4xx bodies
